editorial.blurb: Drip Dessert Lounge is a sugar lover's paradise where beautiful presentations and expertly crafted desserts make choosing nearly impossible.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the staff for recommendations—they're knowledgeable about the full menu and can help you navigate the many tempting options.

topDishes.note: Warm waffle with cookies-and-cream ice cream, chocolate drizzle, crushed Oreos, and fudge sauce
A beloved creation that reviewers called the best they've ever tried
